tools_used: WebFetch (supremecourt.gov PDFs) + local pypdf text extraction
helpful: Full petition text provisioned under record/documents
Statpack band table with bracketed reached rates
CourtListener read_document for the opinion below
gaps: Docket-linked filings beyond the petition and BIO (here the amicus brief and the Rule 15.8 supplemental brief) were not provisioned; fetching PDFs from supremecourt.gov and extracting text locally worked but cost several turns

fedcourts query has no subject or statute filter, so it cannot surface comparable cert petitions (e.g. other HAVA or organizational-standing petitions); its recency ranking returned only emergency applications
read_document returned the whole opinion as one oversized result that had to be sliced from disk; a chunked default for long opinions would help
No provisioned signal for whether a response was called for (the docket had a waiver and no CFR), which was the most decision-relevant fact; a derived cfr_date field in context.json would be useful
notes: Two CourtListener opinion clusters carried the same combined per curiam plus concurrence text; the citation search for 166 F.4th 627 returned nothing, so the case-name search was needed to locate the opinion below.
